title: The invariants 366 and 1188 are anchored to the Wieferich primes

statements.text: The 8D sphere-packing invariants 366 and 1188 are mapped to the two known Wieferich primes, 1093 and 3511, through $(1093 - 1)/3 = 364$ and $(3511 - 1)/3 = 1170$, and the papers conclude that the physical constants are mathematically forced, not arbitrary.

sources.quote: we prove that our physical constants are not arbitrary—they are mathematically forced
